title: CyberPetsAI launch
content: The supplied project materials state that CyberPetsAI launched in August 2024 on Polygon.

title: The Breach: Welcome to Base
content: The supplied story title is “CYBERPETS AI: GLITCHED ARTIFACTS — EPISODE 1: THE BREACH: WELCOME TO BASE.” In this storyline, corrupted companions cross from Polygon into Base as Glitched Artifacts.
